concepts.learning_objective: Define staffing as the function of filling and keeping filled the positions in the organisation structure.
State the benefits that proper staffing brings to an organisation.

topics.title: Staffing as part of Human Resource Management
topics.ncert_sections: Staffing as part of Human Resource Management, Evolution of Human Resource Management

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the specialised duties performed by human resource personnel.
Trace the evolution from labour welfare officer to personnel manager to human resource manager.
Explain why staffing is both a line and a staff activity.
Explain how workload and workforce analysis estimate manpower requirements.
Describe the steps of the staffing process from recruitment to placement and orientation.
Distinguish between time based, performance based and indirect compensation.

topics.title: Recruitment and its sources
topics.ncert_sections: Recruitment, Sources of Recruitment, Internal Sources, External Sources

concepts.learning_objective: Define recruitment and distinguish it from selection.
Explain transfers and promotions with the merits and limitations of internal sources.
Choose suitable external sources of recruitment and state their merits and limitations.
Distinguish between intelligence, aptitude, personality, trade and interest tests.
Describe the steps of the selection process in their proper order.

topics.title: Training and development
topics.ncert_sections: Training and Development, Importance of Training and Development, Training, Development and Education

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish between training, development and education.
State the benefits of training to the organisation and to the employee.

topics.title: Training methods
topics.ncert_sections: Training Methods, On the Job Methods, Off the Job Methods

concepts.learning_objective: Explain apprenticeship, coaching, internship and job rotation as on-the-job methods.
Explain vestibule training, computer modelling and other off-the-job methods.
